aspect:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-spee.collapses: The admission joins the quantity kind si-brochure/speed to this aspect for any bearer that admits speed.
aspect:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-spee.licenses: Stating in an observable that a speed is the bulk flow speed.
aspect:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-spee.not_established: That equal dimension means equal meaning: another speed of the same plasma is not this aspect.

measurement:plasma-populations/near-eart.collapses: Every procedure yielding a speed of this population is admitted alike; instrument, cadence and processing stay in the procedure record.
measurement:plasma-populations/near-eart.licenses: Typing a speed Measure whose bearer is this population, so far for one synthetic consumer.
measurement:plasma-populations/near-eart.not_established: Calibration, validity scope or comparability across procedures.

sort:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-speed.collapses: Direction and components of the bulk flow velocity are collapsed to its magnitude.
sort:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-speed.licenses: Naming the aspect under which a speed of a plasma population is measured. The sort admits the single term plasma-aspect:bulk-flow-speed; the kernel checks identifier syntax only.
sort:plasma-populations/bulk-flow-speed.not_established: That a procedure's output is this property. Thermal, Alfven and sound speeds and velocity components are other aspects and need new sorts.

sort:plasma-populations/near-earth-solar.collapses: Parcels, streams, transient structures and the monitor's position are treated as one population: the unshocked solar-wind plasma upstream of Earth's bow shock that near-Earth monitors sample. No continuity between observations is modelled.
sort:plasma-populations/near-earth-solar.licenses: Naming this population as the bearer of a measured bulk property. The sort admits the single term plasma-population:near-earth-solar-wind; the kernel checks identifier syntax only.
sort:plasma-populations/near-earth-solar.not_established: That any held series samples this population, which is an authored commitment of the measuring procedure. Frame, sampling location, time shift to a reference location and cross-instrument normalization are procedure particulars, not part of the sort.
